query: What company traits explain regional clustering?

per_column.name: industry_sector
per_column.rationale: Clean, interpretable categorical variable (industry) that is external to geography and can be cross-tabulated against regional clusters to reveal sector-based clustering patterns. Some categories are thin (n=1) but the top segments are well-populated and meaningful.

per_column.name: company_type
per_column.rationale: Interpretable segmentation (private/public/investor/startup) that could plausibly associate with regional distribution. Heavily skewed toward 'Private Company' (169), which limits contrast, but remaining categories still allow comparison.

per_column.name: geo_cluster
per_column.rationale: This IS the regional/geographic grouping and essentially restates the focus variable (regional_cluster). Grouping the focus against itself yields no informative external relationship.

per_column.name: tech_focus_level
per_column.rationale: Ordinal Low/Medium/High scale that is external to geography, interpretable, and reasonably distributed, enabling comparison of tech intensity across regions. Somewhat derived/opaque in how it is scored but categories are well-separated.

per_column.name: description_length
per_column.rationale: A mechanical text-metadata artifact with no substantive associational meaning to regional clustering, and highly near-constant (160/199 'Medium'), so no meaningful comparison can be drawn.

judge.rationale: The set contains three genuinely useful associational segmentation variables (industry_sector, company_type, tech_focus_level) that can be cross-tabulated against regional clusters to explore what traits explain clustering. However, geo_cluster restates the focus itself (adding no external relationship), and description_length is a mechanical, near-constant text artifact that realises none of the EDA claim. company_type and tech_focus_level are also somewhat skewed, modestly weakening contrast. Overall the set enables some interpretable relationship discovery but is diluted by one restatement and one irrelevant column.
